text:
maria: Heads up — I just got paged for a latency surge on embeddings-api (p95 spiking ~1.8s, customer-facing). I need to grab a flight in ~25m. Can someone take primary while I’m offline? I’ll do a quick handoff. :airplane:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: embeddings-api latency spike detected — alert #45321 — paging eng-oncall primary.

kevin: I can take primary for the block. What’s the current mitigation state? Any ongoing mitigations I should keep or roll back?

maria: Thanks Kevin. Current state: autoscaler scaled up extra replicas ~5m ago, prefix cache warming in progress, some 503s seen from the batch queue during the spike. No user-visible errors left but latency is elevated. No rollbacks yet.

maria: Quick runbook pointers — top actions: check batch-queue backlog, verify KV cache hit rate, watch autoscaler oscillation. Run these if you need to triage:
```
# check k8s pods + age
kubectl -n inference get deploy embeddings-api -o wide
# inspect queue length (redis list)
redis-cli -h redis.prod.lan LLEN embeddings:batch_queue
# check recent error rates in logs
gcloud logging read "resource.labels.cluster_name=\"prod\" AND jsonPayload.service=\"embeddings-api\"" --limit 50
```

jules: Noted. Who will be secondary? I can shadow if Samir is busy. Also we should update the rotation doc if this extends beyond 30m.

samir: I’ll take secondary for the next 2h. I’ll watch the pager and handle customer escalations. If it persists I’ll open a hotfix PR to reduce batch size.

kevin: Accepted. I’m on primary now — will keep the autoscaler and queue checks running. If latency persists after another 15m I’ll try pinning to the older model build (v2.3) behind the routing policy.

maria: Quick context for the handoff — impact: increased median/95 latency causing some interactive apps to time out at the 1.5s threshold; ~12% of requests at p50-p95 window affected in last 10m. Severity: P2 customer-impact. Customers: a couple of PLG apps reporting slow UX.

triage-bot: Handoff recorded: from maria -> kevin at 1837654340. Secondary: samir. Expected coverage window: 2h.

kevin: Logged my checklist in the incident doc and created a canary route if we need to failover: /routes/embeddings/canary-pin-v2.3. I’ll message if I flip it.

jules: Reminder for escalation path: if we see error rate >5% for 5m or p95 >2s for 10m, escalate to eng-platform (@eng-lead). Also pro tip — if redis backlog >500, temporarily pause batching and enable immediate flush.

samir: I’ll monitor customer channels and the support queue. If customers post a second wave I’ll push a status update.

maria: Thanks everyone. I’m on the plane but reachable for 30m on slack. If you need runbook bits: https://redwood/runbooks/embeddings-api (bookmark). Kevin — you’re primary; Samir — you’re secondary. Please ping me if you promote to on-call lead. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff confirmed — primary set to kevin, secondary set to samir, coverage until 1837658000. Audit id: hb-1837654321-01.

kevin: Confirming acceptance. I’ll post a status update in 15m or sooner if things change.

jules: Leaving a small runbook snippet in thread for whoever picks this up:
- check redis LLEN > 500 -> pause batching
- check autoscaler replicate events -> `kubectl describe hpa embeddings-api`
- check prefix cache hit rate dashboard -> dashboards/embeddings/cache
- if flapping, pin to static capacity and route canary

maria: Perfect. Thanks team — I’ll follow up once landed.

kevin: All good. Taking over.
